{{Quote|He died like everyone dies. A failure, desperate for another breath.''"<br />"''So like his own student. Ikoral's greatest apprentice was my Master. He died for his lack of vision as well, after he taught me what it meant to be Sith.|An Imperial combatant and Darth Malgus discuss Darth Ikoral and Vindican|<ref name="Red Reaper" />}}
'''Darth Vindican''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the early days of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Having been trained in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by the conservative [[Darth Ikoral]], Vindican advanced to the rank of [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] and took an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of his own&mdash;the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]].

In [[3681 BBY]], Vindican and Malgus joined an [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] of Imperial [[Harrower-class dreadnought|battlecruisers]] to [[Battle of Korriban|retake]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]. After they engaged the small Republic force over Korriban, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Master and Malgus boarded a [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|shuttle]], docked with the Republic's [[Korriban's orbital security station|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Korriban, and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|attacked]] two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defenders&mdash;a [[Kao Cen Darach|Zabrak Master]] and his [[Satele Shan|Human apprentice]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] incapacitated his Sith counterpart, but Malgus soon [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Jedi before he was able to kill his injured master.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Welcome home.|Malgus, to Vindican, prior to the latter's death.|<ref name="return" />}}
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]]<ref name="Investigate">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220204|text=Legacy of the Sith: Digital Collector's Edition}}</ref> Vindican<ref name="name">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20110812-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday}}</ref> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] who lived during the era of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] return to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="return" /> Vindican was [[Sith training|trained]] in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], the legendary [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] hero, [[Darth Ikoral]], and was widely believed to be the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord's]] greatest student.<ref name="Red Reaper" /> Around [[3712 BBY]], Ikoral, a firm believer in the superiority of the Sith species, led an [[Darth Ikoral's expedition|expedition]] into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to find any surviving colonies of Purebloods.<ref name="Red Reaper" /> Now master-less, Vindican advanced to the level of Sith Lord<ref name="name" /> and took an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of his own&mdash;the young and talented [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]]. The two served the Sith Empire during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Galactic War]],<ref name="return" /> and in [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline6date" /> the Sith Master and his apprentice joined the Empire's campaign to [[Battle of Korriban|retake]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]],<ref name="return" /> which had been under [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] control. An [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] of thirty Imperial [[Harrower-class dreadnought|battlecruisers]], including Vindican and Malgus, [[Hyperspace/Legends|jumped]] to Korriban [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and engaged the small Republic force stationed there.<ref name="return" />

[[File:Sith_penetrated.png|thumb|left|300px|Vindican wounded by Darach]]
Vindican and Malgus detached from the Imperial fleet and boarded a [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|shuttle]] to dock with the Republic's [[Korriban's orbital security station|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Korriban. After they landed in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on the station, the Sith Master, flanked by Malgus, spotted two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]],<ref name="return" /> [[Kao Cen Darach]],<ref name="name" /> and his Human [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Satele Shan]]&mdash;and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|confronted]] them. With his [[Vindican's lightsaber|double-bladed lightsaber]], Vindican attacked his Jedi counterpart, while Malgus fought Shan. The Sith Master advanced against Darach, whom he engaged in a swift flurry of swordplay before he unleashed a volley of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at Shan. After he was [[The Force/Legends|Force-pushed]] across the hangar by the Jedi Master, Vindican blasted lightning at an escaping [[Nico Okarr|smuggler's]] [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|freighter]]&mdash;the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] in which the Jedi intended to escape the station.<ref name="return" />

Shan boarded the departing [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and left her master behind to fight Vindican and Malgus alone, although Shan tossed her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] so her master could stand a better chance. The Sith Master engaged Darach once again, in an attack coordinated with the flanking Malgus. When the Sith Master unleashed lightning at the Zabrak, Darach [[Tutaminis|deflected]] it toward Malgus. Darach's two lightsabers also struck the right side of Sith Master's head, which lifted his helmet off his face and left a [[Shiim/Legends|scar]] over his right [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. Vindican was incapacitated when Darach activated one of the ends of Shan's double-bladed weapon [[Shiak|through]] the Sith's abdomen. The Sith Master's fallen double-bladed weapon was taken by Malgus, who engaged and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Darach with it. After Malgus returned to Vindican, he exchanged words with him, before executing him.<ref name="return" />

Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Legacy Reborn Date">{{TOR_updates|7.9}}</ref> years after his death, Vindican's memory tormented Malgus at the abandoned [[Naga Sadow's fortress|fortress]] of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] on the Sith [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Khar Shian]]. While unlocking the secrets of [[Darth Nul]]'s machine, Malgus faced the memories of his past.<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|They escaped, Master. You failed.''"<br />"''No, Malgus. This&hellip;is only the beginning!|Malgus and Vindican, shortly before the latter's death|<ref name="return" />}}
[[File:Korriban_duel_now_with_lightning.png|thumb|right|250px|Vindican attacking Darach with Force Lightning]]
The aggressive Vindican had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin and yellow eyes. During the fight on the Korriban space station, he gained a scar on his right eye. When the Pureblood Sith did not stop Darach's apprentice from leaving the station, his apprentice, Malgus, regarded him as a failure; however, Vindican believed that it was only the beginning of the Sith's reemergence. Before the Sith Master was killed, he was welcomed home by Malgus, since Korriban was the ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Sith.<ref name="return" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:VindicanSaber-Return.png|thumb|left|300px|Vindican's lightsaber]]
Vindican was a Sith Master,<ref name="return" /> Lord,<ref name="name" /> and [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> He was skilled in the art of lightsaber combat as demonstrated during his fight with Darach on the Republic's Korriban space station. With his [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Vindican was also able to deflect a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] that was launched from a [[Jace Malcom|trooper's]] [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]]. However, during their fight, the Sith Master failed to see Darach's deactivated blade end which was pointed at his midsection. When the Jedi activated it, the lightsaber's blade stabbed Vindican. After falling in battle, his apprentice forced the saber from Vindican's hand and utilised it, to lethal effect, against the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] Darach of the Jedi Order.<ref name="return" />

==Equipment==
Vindican wore a [[Sith apparel|hooded]] black, gray, red, and gold [[Robe/Legends|robe]] with a mask that covered his face and [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. He wielded a red double-bladed lightsaber in combat.<ref name="return" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vindican first appeared as an unidentified Pureblood Sith in [[Return (cinematic trailer)|''Return'']], a cinematic trailer for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' that was released on [[June 6]], [[2011]].<ref name="return" /> A few months after the trailer's release, Vindican received his name in an article that was published in ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} official website on [[August 12]], 2011.<ref name="name" /> He was later confirmed to hold the title of Darth in an article published over 10 years later, on [[February 4]], [[2022]].<ref name="Investigate" />
